items.title: Approve the Minutes of the October 7, 2025 Meeting Consent Agenda
Reappoint Austin Milford-Rosales and Najuawanda Daniels as the District 6 and District 10 Representatives
Prop K Standard Grant Agreement for the Mission Bay School Access Plan to Allow $30,000 in Funds Held in Reserve
Allocate $6,606,363 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, and Allocate $1,100,000 in Prop AA Funds
Amend the One Bay Area Grant Cycle 2 Project List and the Prop K Standard Grant Agreement for the Bay Area Rapid Transit
Approve San Francisco?s Program of Projects for the 2026 Regional Transportation Improvement Program, Totaling $9,887,000
Authorize Borrowing of up to $60,000,000 under the Amended and Restated Revolving Credit Agreement with U.S. Bank National
